title: Payment step 7 — BCCR's Hub position reconciles: balanced true, unexplained zero
description: Treasury-facing. With the swap settled and the residue returned, nothing is in flight and nothing is unattributed: the Central Bank's omnibus Hub balance is fully explained.
notes: Gateway: BCCR Central Bank gateway. Accepts a bearer token as well as the cookie, and requires the central_bank realm role. unexplained is the number that matters and balanced is true exactly when it is zero; stranded_total is context, not a deduction, and unattributed covers settled positions whose trade cost was never recorded — deliberately excluded from expected_in_flight because on-chain they hold nothing. A read failure answers 500: this endpoint reports an error rather than fabricating a benign zero, which is the right behaviour for a reconciliation surface. BCCR's own 500,000 W-tCeBM_CRC seed is not counted here because it now sits in the AMM, not in the omnibus address.
